description: This file defines the ExoticFontsFontResolver class, which implements IFontResolver to map font requests for SegoeWP fonts to specific embedded font resources. It includes methods to resolve typefaces based on family names and retrieve font byte data.

classes.name: ExoticFontsFontResolver
classes.description: Implements IFontResolver to resolve font typefaces and retrieve font data for specific embedded fonts.

methods.name: ResolveTypeface
methods.description: Resolves a font family name and style (bold, italic) to a specific font resource, returning FontResolverInfo or null if not found.

methods.name: GetFont
methods.description: Returns the byte array of the font corresponding to the given face name, or null if not available.
